questions.question: You need to ensure that users are added to a group automatically when their Department attribute is set to Sales, and removed when the attribute changes. What should you configure?

options.text: A security group with the Dynamic User membership type and the rule (user.department -eq "Sales")
options.why: Correct. Dynamic User membership evaluates user properties and adds or removes members automatically.

options.text: A security group with the Assigned membership type and the Sales department as the owner
options.why: Owners manage an assigned group manually. Membership does not follow the Department attribute.

options.text: A Microsoft 365 group with the Dynamic Device membership type
options.why: Dynamic Device rules evaluate device properties, not user properties such as department.

options.text: An administrative unit that contains the Sales department users
options.why: Administrative units scope administration. They do not add users to groups.

questions.explanation: Dynamic membership rules use user properties such as user.department. Membership is recalculated when the property changes.

questions.question: Your organization plans to use dynamic groups in Microsoft Entra ID. Which license is required for the users who are members of the dynamic groups?

options.text: Microsoft Entra ID P1
options.why: Correct. Dynamic membership requires Microsoft Entra ID P1 or higher for users in scope.

options.text: Microsoft Entra ID Free
options.why: The Free edition does not include dynamic membership groups.

options.text: An Azure subscription with the Owner role
options.why: Azure RBAC roles do not license Microsoft Entra features.

options.text: Microsoft Defender for Cloud
options.why: Defender for Cloud protects workloads. It does not license directory features.

questions.explanation: Dynamic membership groups require Microsoft Entra ID P1 (or P2) licenses.

questions.question: An administrator attempts to add User1 to a group named Sales-Team, but the Add members option is unavailable. Other groups accept new members. What is the most likely cause?

options.text: Sales-Team uses the Dynamic User membership type
options.why: Correct. Members of a dynamic group are determined only by its rule and cannot be added manually.

options.text: Sales-Team is a security group
options.why: Security groups with assigned membership accept manual members.

options.text: User1 does not have a usage location
options.why: Usage location affects license assignment, not group membership.

options.text: Sales-Team has more than one owner
options.why: The number of owners does not prevent members from being added.

questions.explanation: To include User1 in a dynamic group, change the user property that the membership rule evaluates.

questions.question: You need to create 400 cloud-only user accounts from a spreadsheet provided by HR with the least administrative effort. What should you use?

options.text: Bulk create in the Users blade with the provided CSV template
options.why: Correct. Bulk create imports users from a CSV template in one operation.

options.text: Microsoft Entra Connect
options.why: Entra Connect synchronizes users from on-premises Active Directory. The users are cloud-only.

options.text: The Create new user wizard for each user
options.why: This works but requires 400 separate operations.

options.text: An Azure Policy assignment
options.why: Azure Policy governs Azure resources. It does not create directory users.

questions.explanation: Bulk operations support bulk create, bulk invite and bulk delete by using CSV templates.

questions.question: You need to create a group that can be assigned the Helpdesk Administrator Microsoft Entra role. Which two settings must be configured when you create the group? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.

options.text: Set Group type to Security
options.why: Correct. Role-assignable groups are security groups (or Microsoft 365 groups), and Security is the usual choice.

options.text: Set Microsoft Entra roles can be assigned to the group to Yes
options.why: Correct. This setting must be enabled at creation and cannot be changed later.

options.text: Set Membership type to Dynamic User
options.why: Role-assignable groups cannot use dynamic membership.

options.text: Assign the group the Owner role on the subscription
options.why: Azure RBAC roles are unrelated to Microsoft Entra role assignment.

questions.explanation: A role-assignable group must have the Microsoft Entra roles can be assigned to the group option enabled when it is created, and its membership must be assigned.
